title: Fit-to-width mobile composition made the 303-node map technically complete but practically unreadable
tool: Chromium via Workstation Playwright binding + Runtime visual inspection
workflow: 390x844 mobile consumption -> inspect full-page screenshot -> revise map viewport -> re-consume
symptom: The first responsive pass squeezed the complete 1600-wide conceptual field into a narrow phone card, preserving all nodes but destroying useful spatial legibility.
expected_behavior: Mobile should preserve readable spatial scale without creating page-level horizontal overflow.
actual_behavior: A mathematically responsive fit was visually too small to consume.
proposed_fix: Keep document width constrained, but make the map region an internally pannable 820px field on narrow viewports with a visible pan affordance.
fix_attempt: Added .map-viewport internal x-scroll and a PAN MAP hint while preserving the detail panel below it.
verification: At 390x844, document overflow=0, map viewport clientWidth=364, scrollWidth=820, and programmatic pan reached scrollLeft=228; 303 nodes/45 relations remained present and console errors=0.
